tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len tshigs bcad ma bzhugs// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs bral bla ma dam pa dang*// sgyu ma'i tshul 'chang sprul sku dang*// bde chen zag med longs sku dang*// gnyis med byang sems chos sku dang*// spros bral khyab bdag ngo bo'i skur// phyag 'tshal byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de nas de dag bsgrub don du// dbang ni rnam pa bzhi po las// bum pa'i dbang bskur bla mas bstan// mchog dbang gsum po bri bar bya// ji ltar de yi cho ga ni// phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon song nas// snyim pa me tog bcas thal mos// gus pas btud nas gsol ba gdab// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes pa// khyod ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje'i yid kyis dgyes// lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab// 'bru gsum brjod cing gdong g.yogs bcing*// slob dpon rang nyid he ru ka /yum dang gnyis su med par bskyed// mkha' gsang byin rlabs snyoms zhugs pas// ha ha si si kun du ru// badz+ra dhṛka ces bya ba'i sgras// phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs spyan drangs la// zhal du zhugs nas 'od du zhu// yum gyi gsang bar thig ler gyur// slob ma'i lce la bzhag par bsam// slob mas kyang ni drin du gzhug /dngos su bdud rtsi myang byas la// ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gi ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// 'bru gsum brjod nas lus la bstim// rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags// de tshe bla ma yum bcas pa// mgrin par zhugs pas rkyen byas nas// gsung dag dpag med mgon du gyur// 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi yis// slob ma dam pa bsrung bar bya// gdong g.yogs phye la bha ga yi// dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brda zhes brjod// lung bstan gsang ba'i mtha' rten te// longs sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin// dbang bskur gsum pa thob bya'i phyir// phyag dang maṇ+ḍal sngon song nas// me tog thal sbyar gsol ba gdab// bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// lan gsum gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing*// 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor// slob ma kye yi rdo rjer bskyed// mdun du rdo rje bdag med ma// skad cig gis ni dran du gzhug

/slob dpon gyis ni 'di skad brjod// lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// de ltar gtad la tshig 'dis dri// bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes pas slob mar bdag med mas// dris par bsam zhing lan 'di gdab// bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par cis mi spro// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed pa// bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to// slob mas de skad lan btab pas// de mnyes de yi gos bral nas// dri med pad+ma kha phye ste// bha ga'i dkyil 'khor legs par bstan// de yi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs// e ma 'o nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// ji ltar cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// bya ba pad+mar ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// de skad phan yon nyes dmigs dang*// bcas pas spro ba bskyed byas nas// slob ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pa// sku gsum du ni byin brlabs te// de ltar skal ba mnyam par byas// gal te nyon mongs shas che na// 'du shes byin rlabs dgos pa dang*// thabs la mkhas pa'i khyad par te// chos bzhi rtogs par byas nas su// tshul min yid byed spang bar bya// de lta'i sbyor ba la mkhas pas// snyoms zhugs dbang gi dwangs ma rnams// dbu ma'i lam nas rigs bdag khar// babs nas yum gyi rak+ta dang*// bcas pa 'dres pas gzas zin dus// de yi rlung gi nus pa yis// byang sems rim gyis dbang du bsdu// gnad gsum man ngag shin tu gces/

bdud rtsis bsrung zhing gdong g.yogs dbye// kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ni// dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i brda zhes bstan// dbugs dbyung gsum pa'i mtha' rten te// chos sku'i rten 'brel 'grigs pa yin// dbang bskur bzhi pa bya ba'i phyir// phyag sogs sngon song gsol ba gdab// bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// lan gsum gsol gdab gdong g.yogs bcing*// 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsis gtor// lus kyis 'khrul 'khor ldan byas nas// dam pas de la 'di skad brjod// ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid// khyod rang yang ni de yi pha// de yang rang gi sems nyid yin// thog mtha' med cing skye 'gag med// dngos po kun gyi chos nyid de// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zhes// ngo sprod tshig gi bzhi pa'o// de yi ye shes skye ba ni// don gyi bzhi pa phyag rgya dang*// bcas pa rten can dus kun tu// goms byed lam gyi bzhi pa'o// 'gros bzhi thim nas grub pa gang*// mngon du byed pa bzhi pa ste// de ltar ye shes ngo sprad nas// 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi yis// gtor nas slob ma bsrung bar bya// gdong g.yogs phye la don dam pa// byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor ni// mthong ngo zhes ni brjod par bya// gzengs bstod bzhi pa'i mtha' rten te// sku bzhi'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin// mjug gi cho ga gzhan du gsal// de ltar smin par byas pa yi// mchog dbang rnam pa gsum po 'di// bla ma'i phyag len ji lta bar// blo dman gzhan la phan pa'i phyir// nyung ngus rtogs byed kho bos bgyis// 'di la nyes pa mchis gyur na// dpal ldan mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// brtse bas bzod par mdzad du gsol// dge des 'gro ba ma lus rnams// srid dang mya ngan 'das spangs nas// sku gsum 'bras bu thob par shog

/dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len gyi rim pa/ bla mas ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin du/ rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// 'dis bstan pa dang sems can thams cad la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung bar gyur cig /ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya wa data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
